Abba Atiku Abubakar, son of former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, has pledged 10 buses to support mobilisation for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election campaign ahead of the 2027 general elections. Abba made the pledge during a visit to the All Progressives Congress National Secretariat in Abuja on Friday, according to a statement issued by the party’s Senior Special Assistant on Youth Mobilisation to the Deputy National Chairman, Yusi Buba. He was received by the APC Deputy National Chairman (North), Bukar Dalori, during the visit. Buba said Abba commended the party’s leadership and Tinubu’s administration, expressing support for the President’s continuity in office. “In a demonstration of his commitment to the political engagement ahead of the 2027 general elections, Hon. Abba Atiku Abubakar announced the donation of ten buses to support activities aimed at mobilising support for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and Vice President Kashim Shettima in 2027,” the statement said. Nasarawa APC senatorial candidate urges unity ahead of 2027 elections APC chieftain cautions Bayelsa PDP chair against attacks on Diri 2027: Police train officers in Jigawa for election security The development followed Abba’s announcement of a nationwide mobilisation plan for Tinubu’s re-election and the unveiling of the Haske Bola Tinubu Organisation, a political support platform. Speaking at a press conference in Abuja on Friday, Abba said the organisation would begin its activities in the Federal Capital Territory before expanding to other parts of the country. He also announced plans for a two-million-man mobilisation march across the six geopolitical zones, beginning in Abuja. Abba had defected from the Peoples Democratic Party to the APC in January, declaring support for Tinubu’s second-term ambition. Abba’s father, Atiku, is the presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress for the 2027 general election.
